engine.autoInstallHintAfter: . The first run downloads a few tens of MB.
engine.autoInstallHintBefore: This creates a separate environment inside Magplot's own folder and installs matplotlib into it.
engine.autoInstallHintStrong: None of your existing Python environments are touched
engine.bundledHint: The common scientific stack (numpy / matplotlib / pandas / scipy / seaborn / Pillow) ships with Magplot, so you do not need to install Python and the first render works offline.
engine.incompleteAfter: — please reinstall Magplot. If antivirus software removed it, add Magplot's install folder to the allowlist afterwards.
engine.incompleteHint: Layout, annotation and export are unaffected; only figure-element editing needs the rendering environment. Settings → “Environment diagnostics” can export a diagnostics bundle.
engine.missingBody: Figure-element editing needs a Python with matplotlib. Magplot runs your own scripts, so the interpreter has to be able to import the libraries they use. Layout, annotation and export are unaffected.
engine.missingModuleBody: Magplot bundles the common scientific stack (numpy / matplotlib / pandas / scipy / seaborn / Pillow). This script needs something else — point the rendering environment at the Python / Conda environment you normally run it in.
engine.missingModuleNoteBefore: Magplot only launches it to render;
engine.missingModuleNoteStrong: nothing is ever installed into it
engine.noPythonAfter: (or Anaconda) first, then come back here.
engine.noPythonBefore: No usable Python was found on this machine. Install
engine.pathPlaceholder: /path/to/python, or the python inside a conda environment
engine.useOtherHintAfter: — it only launches it to render.
engine.useOtherHintBefore: Switch to your own environment when a script needs packages the bundled one lacks (rdkit, astropy…). Apply with the field empty to go back to the default. Magplot
engine.useOtherHintStrong: never modifies the environment you choose

preflight.axisLabelFormat: The axis title “{{label}}” is not in the profile's “{{want}}” form
preflight.barWithoutErrorbar: The bar chart has no error bars — if these bars are means of repeated measurements, the profile expects the error shown
preflight.bitmapEmbed: Flipped or semi-transparent panels are embedded in the PDF as bitmaps at export DPI; vector text is not preserved
preflight.cjkFallbackMissing: Text containing CJK characters uses {{family}} with no CJK fallback declared — it will come out as boxes in the exported PDF
preflight.discouragedColormap: The colormap {{cmap}} is not perceptually uniform; the profile recommends {{recommended}}
preflight.fitWithoutCi: There is a fitted curve but no confidence band — submissions usually require the uncertainty of the fit
preflight.fontBelowFloor: Figure text at an effective {{effective}}pt is not above the absolute floor of {{floor}}pt
preflight.fontFamilySubstituted: Figure text uses {{family}}; the profile requires {{want}}
preflight.fontFamilySubstitutedKnown: Figure text uses {{family}}; the profile requires {{want}} (that font is a common substitute, which means the intended one is not installed)
preflight.fontTooLarge: Figure text at an effective {{effective}}pt exceeds {{max}}pt, which is usually larger than body text
preflight.fontTooSmall: Figure text at an effective {{effective}}pt is below the profile's {{min}}pt
preflight.frameWidthOffPreset: The frame's effective line width {{effective}}pt is not one of the profile's steps ({{presets}}pt)
preflight.hidden: Hidden objects will not appear in the export
preflight.legendFontSize: The legend's effective font size {{effective}}pt is outside the profile's {{min}}–{{max}}pt
preflight.legendFrame: The legend has a frame; the profile requires a frameless legend
preflight.lineWidthOffPreset: The effective line width {{effective}}pt is not one of the profile's steps ({{presets}}pt)
preflight.missingAsset: A panel references an asset that is not in the current figure library; export will fail or come out blank
preflight.outOfPage: An object extends past the page; the part outside will not appear in the output
preflight.outsideMargin: An object crosses the {{margin}}mm safe-area margin
preflight.overlap: Panels overlap each other — make sure the overlap is intentional before exporting
preflight.pageAspect: The page aspect {{ratio}} ({{w}}×{{h}}mm) is not one of the allowed ratios ({{allowed}})
preflight.pageWidth: The page width {{actual}}mm is not one of the profile's column widths ({{want}}mm)
preflight.paletteLineMarkers: All {{count}} lines are drawn without markers, which is hard to tell apart in black-and-white print or for colorblind readers — consider markers or distinct line styles
preflight.paletteSemantic: The colormap {{cmap}} is not one of the recommended scientific palettes (pick by sequential / diverging / categorical meaning: {{url}})
preflight.panelTextNotVerifiable: This vector panel has no engine manifest yet (not rendered, or not produced by a script), so its text size and font cannot be checked automatically
preflight.rasterDpi: The raster panel's effective resolution {{dpi}}dpi is below the profile's {{min}}dpi
preflight.rasterTextNotVerifiable: Text inside a raster panel cannot be checked automatically (there is no vector text layer) — please confirm by hand that its final size clears the profile's floor
preflight.renderError: This panel's last render failed — fix it before exporting
preflight.spinesNotEnclosed: The axes are not enclosed (missing {{sides}}); the profile requires enclosed axes
preflight.staleRender: The panel's script changed but has not been rebuilt — the export would use the old figure
preflight.textBelowFloor: Canvas text at {{size}}pt is not above the absolute floor of {{floor}}pt
preflight.textCjkFallbackMissing: Canvas text in Chinese has no usable CJK font fallback
preflight.textTooSmall: Canvas text at {{size}}pt is below the profile's {{min}}pt
preflight.tickDirection: Tick direction is {{got}}; the profile requires {{want}}
preflight.tickLabelCount: {{axis}} has {{count}} tick labels; the profile suggests keeping it under {{max}}
preflight.unappliedOverride: {{count}} figure edits on this panel have not been applied to the render, so the output will not match the canvas
